recommendation.rationale: The automated panel is useful challenge evidence and has complete role-shaped coverage, but it exposes a Critical catastrophic-harm contract gap, numerous High scientific, source, governance, API, estimator, domain and eligibility gaps, and three Medium gaps. No finding has been remediated or independently re-reviewed. The only defensible current course is to preserve the non-runtime boundary, address repository-owned findings, obtain independent source evidence and qualified reviewers, then freeze a new packet for accountable review.
